name: AlphaSense AI — Multi-Model Deep Learning Trading System
description: Built a multi-branch deep learning trading system fusing Temporal Fusion Transformer, Bidirectional Mamba, Stockformer (CNN-Transformer), and Graph Attention Network outputs with regime-conditioned gating, DRL ensemble (PPO, A2C, DDPG), and a FastAPI dashboard deployed on Hugging Face Spaces.
bullets: Fused Temporal Fusion Transformer, Bidirectional Mamba, Stockformer (CNN-Transformer), and Graph Attention Network branches via cross-attention with regime-conditioned gating.
Implemented a Deep Reinforcement Learning ensemble (PPO, A2C, DDPG) on Stable-Baselines3 with custom Gymnasium continuous action spaces and risk-adjusted reward shaping.
Engineered a 64-feature pipeline with CEEMDAN signal decomposition and Hidden Markov Model (HMM) regime detection plus online incremental fine-tuning.
Deployed a full-stack FastAPI backend and JavaScript dashboard on Hugging Face Spaces with live technical indicators and Gemini API rationale generation.
